title: I woke up thinking about you
author: Lopamudra Mishra
text:
I woke up thinking about you
And about your melodious tune
How beautifully you absorbed our relationship
In the lyrics and so also in the singing intonation
The tone is graceful
The tenor is elegant
The lyrical ballad is captivating
Those words run in my mind
Heart sings the rhyme
Lips quiver time to time
I utter your name in silence a million time
I connect your picture in different frames
I see your face in different waves
The lyrical web is playing the game
Making me to explore
The words beneath the words
